## Files

```{r}
#| label: manifest
#| output: asis
if (!atlas_ready) {
  not_built()
} else {
  man <- fread(file.path(web_dir, "downloads-manifest.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8")
  size <- ifelse(man$bytes >= 1e6, sprintf("%.1f MB", man$bytes / 1e6), sprintf("%.0f kB", man$bytes / 1e3))
  rows <- sprintf(
    '<tr><td><a href="%s" download>%s</a></td><td><span class="fmt">%s</span></td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td class="num">%s</td></tr>',
    man$href, man$file, man$format, man$description, man$license, size
  )
  cat(
    '<div class="table-responsive"><table class="table downloads"><thead><tr>',
    "<th>File</th><th>Format</th><th>Contents</th><th>Licence</th><th>Size</th>",
    "</tr></thead><tbody>", rows, "</tbody></table></div>",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

Versioned snapshots of every monthly build are attached to the [GitHub releases](https://github.com/alirezach/iran-health-atlas/releases).

## Licences and attribution

All files may be redistributed. Conditions come from the inputs:

- **Derived from OpenStreetMap** (hospitals, travel times, every indicator): [Open Database License 1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). Credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors" and share adapted databases under the same licence.
- **Population grid**: WorldPop (CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5258/SOTON/WP00670) and geoBoundaries (CC BY 4.0). Credit both.
- **Code**: MIT.

Suggested citation: *Chamanzar, A. (2026). Iran Health Accessibility Atlas (v1.0.0). https://alirezach.github.io/iran-health-atlas/*
